## Presentation Materials

*Slides and recordings will be added here after each session.*

**For each session, we will provide:**

- **Slides**: Direct download links
- **Recording**: YouTube video links  
- **Resources**: Additional materials and references
- **Lab Materials**: Tutorial notebooks and code

*This section will be updated progressively as the summer school proceeds.*

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Color code table rows based on session content and handle mobile layout
  const tables = document.querySelectorAll('table');
  
  tables.forEach(table => {
    const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
    
    rows.forEach(row => {
      const sessionCell = row.querySelector('td:nth-child(2)');
      if (!sessionCell) return;
      
      const sessionText = sessionCell.textContent.toLowerCase();
      
      // Add session type class for coloring
      if (sessionText.includes('keynote')) {
        row.classList.add('session-keynote');
      } else if (sessionText.includes('tutorial') || sessionText.includes('lab')) {
        row.classList.add('session-tutorial');
      } else if (sessionText.includes('break') || sessionText.includes('lunch')) {
        row.classList.add('session-break');
      } else if (sessionText.includes('registration')) {
        row.classList.add('session-registration');
      } else {
        row.classList.add('session-speaker');
      }
      
      // Mark empty cells for mobile hiding
      const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td');
      cells.forEach(cell => {
        const content = cell.textContent.trim();
        if (content === '-' || content === '') {
          cell.setAttribute('data-empty', 'true');
        }
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
